why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open raflux.io/quests and sign in with Google or a wallet. "Google sign-in: Privy creates an embedded Solana wallet for your account. No wallet extension is required."
Do the one-off quests: connect X, connect Telegram and verify your email.
Check in every day to keep the streak, and do the X tasks while they're up.
Share your referral link from the Refer and Earn page if you want. "Self-referral is not permitted."
costs: Signing up and the quests are free. Pulls cost 10 to 100 USDC each plus network fees. "Raflux does not add a platform fee to Super Gacha pulls, buyback, or physical redemption." Selling an item back loses at least 10%, and "Collectors pay shipping for domestic and international delivery." In the raffle marketplace, "an entry does not guarantee an item."
risks: "You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your place of residence if higher." There's no list of excluded countries; you may use Raflux "only where your use is permitted by applicable law".
